title: Menus failing on MacOS when using iPad as a second display
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in 4.5.1 stable (haven't tested other versions) ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable - macOS Sequoia (15.3.2) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon Pro 5600M OpenGL Engine - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9880H CPU @ 2.30GHz (16 threads) - 64.00 GiB memory ### Issue description When using an iPad as an extended display via Screen Mirroring AFTER launching the engine, any menu option that creates a new window within the engine will fail to execute, leaving this error in the console. (this is the result of trying to right-click on a node) ``` ERROR: platform/macos/gl_manager_macos_legacy.mm:56 - Parameter "win.context" is null. ERROR: Can't create an OpenGL context. ERROR: platform/macos/display_server_macos.mm:2570 - Condition "!windows.has(p_window)" is true. ERROR: platform/macos/display_server_macos.mm:2570 - Condition "!windows.has(p_window)" is true. ERROR: platform/macos/display_server_macos.mm:2570 - Condition "!windows.has(p_window)" is true. ERROR: platform/macos/display_server_macos.mm:2570 - Condition "!windows.has(p_window)" is true. ERROR: platform/macos/display_server_macos.mm:2570 - Condition "!windows.has(p_window)" is true. ERROR: platform/macos/display_server_macos.mm:2570 - Condition "!windows.has(p_window)" is true. ERROR: platform/macos/display_server_macos.mm:2570 - Condition "!windows.has(p_window)" is true. ERROR: platform/macos/display_server_macos.mm:2570 - Condition "!windows.has(p_window)" is true. ERROR: platform/macos/display_server_macos.mm:2090 - Condition "!windows.has(p_window)" is true. ERROR: platform/macos/display_server_macos.mm:2178 - Condition "!windows.has(p_window)" is true. ERROR: scene/main/window.cpp:670 - Condition "window_id == DisplayServer::INVALID_WINDOW_ID" is true. ERROR: platform/macos/display_server_macos.mm:1990 - Condition "!windows.has(p_window)" is true Returning: INVALID_SCREEN ``` So far I've reproduced this with: - the right-click menu - the Project Settings menu - the Command Palatte - Export But I'm inferring that any menu that opens a new window will result in the same error. ### Steps to reproduce - Launch the Godot engine - Open a project to edit - Start Screen Mirroring to iPad - Trigger a new menu window (such as the ones I listed in the previous description) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) This is the project that I've been working on where I encountered this, but it should also occur on any other project. [3d-horror-thing.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24319454/3d-horror-thing.zip)
